rows: The named pair is retained; the surrounding agent, messenger, and audience roles need explicit index coverage.
Enrollment, attendance, activity, parentage, and binary membership are separated. Four proposed meanings of β fail to distinguish the pair.
No exact instrument is assigned by this review. The spirit-imparting event remains recorded without inventing one.
Shared responsibility is not transcribed as an octave descent or new biological generation. No register movement is supplied merely by “imparting.”
The narrative contains instructions, occurrences, reports, requests, wishes, and a return. Duration is witness-sensitive; exact synchronization remains unspecified.
$B$ preserves the pair; selection is not muting; report is not fulfillment; shared responsibility is not succession.
Base Numbers, Onkelos, Sanhedrin, Pseudo-Jonathan, Greek, Latin, and Arabic readings retain their own consequences. No composite has been silently adopted.
